name.value: Best Western Plus Valemount Inn & Suites

description.value: A Best Western Plus property in Valemount, BC, positioned at the gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park and the Rocky Mountains. The hotel features an indoor pool, waterslide, and hot tub, along with suites offering kitchenettes and mountain views — useful for cyclists needing to dry out and recover after a long day on Highway 5. Valemount is a key overnight stop on the Icefields Parkway corridor and this is one of the town's most prominent full-service lodging options.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash station, laundry, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null per rules.
concerns: Website address shows '1950 Highway 5 S' while OSM uses '1950 Southern Yellowhead Highway' — these refer to the same road but the naming difference may cause confusion. OSM value retained per rules.
Hotel direct phone number (+1-250-566-0086) could not be confirmed from website content; only the central BW reservations number (1-800-780-7234) appears in the fetched text.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel in Valemount — a key cycling hub on the Highway 5 / Yellowhead corridor. Clear value to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation.
